{{Quote|Greets to you! And welcome to the Lok Station.|A space station operator to an incoming pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Lok Station''', otherwise known as the '''Lok Space Station''', was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in the [[Karthakk system]]. It cleared ships for landing at the small [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] of [[Nym's Stronghold]] and provided emergency repairs for damaged starships.
